item.title: SPPF Malaysia unveils new automotive paint protection
item.description: PETALING JAYA: SPPF Malaysia has introduced its next-generation spray-on paint protection system, billed as providing unparalleled durability and visual clarity. At a recent showcase at AutoDetailer Studio, the company unveiled its sprayed-on, future-proof protective film that forms an adhesive-free layer on a vehicle’s paintwork through proprietary Paintwork Fusion Bonding technology. item.title: Volvo Cars to recall 40,000 electric SUVs over battery fire risk
item.description: STOCKHOLM: Volvo Cars will recall over 40,000 of its flagship electric EX30 SUVs because their battery packs risk overheating, it told Reuters, a move that could dent the automaker’s hard-earned reputation for safety and cost it millions of dollars. The previously unreported recall involves replacing modules in the high-voltage battery packs of the compact SUV, [...]

item.title: Liberty General Insurance introduces EV 365 Care
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Liberty General Insurance has introduced EV 365 Care, a customised optional add-on package designed for electric vehicle (EV) and plug-in hybrid vehicle (PHEV) owners. EV 365 Care provides coverage that reflects how EV owners live, commute, and charge their vehicles. With 24-hour towing assistance for out-of-charge situations, EV 365 Care offers unlimited towing [...]

item.title: European auto sales fall even as EV demand cushions the drop
item.description: PARIS: European car sales fell in January, breaking a six-month growth streak as consumer reticence in several markets overshadowed still-robust demand for electrified models. New-vehicle registrations declined 3.5% to 961,382 last month, the European Automobile Manufacturers’ Association said. France and the region’s biggest market Germany led the drop, while sales rose in the UK and [...]

item.title: ZF sees debt relief from slower EV transition
item.description: MUNICH: ZF Friedrichshafen AG is getting some reprieve from its debt burden with the slower shift to electric cars boosting demand for key components such as gearboxes. Changing course from an EV-first approach to selling parts for EVs, hybrids and fuel-burning cars will help bolster the company’s balance sheet, Chief Financial Officer Michael Frick said [...]

item.description: LONDON: Chery International’s Lepas marque has confirmed that its flagship L8 SUV (sport utility vehicle) will go on sale in the UK in the third quarter of 2026. item.title: EU lobby wants tighter emission rules for corporate cars
item.description: PARIS: The European Union should make companies include more environmentally friendly vehicles in their corporate fleets, and exclude low-emission vehicles and plug-in hybrids from quotas, environmental group Transport & Environment said. item.title: Wayve raises US$1.5bil for robotaxi wars
item.description: LONDON: Wayve, the UK autonomous driving software startup, has raised US$1.5 billion (RM5.84bil) in funding at an US$8.6 billion (RM33.5bil) valuation as it prepares to go up against Chinese and US rivals to roll out self-driving taxis. The funding comprises US$1.2 billion (RM4.67bil) from lead investors Eclipse Ventures LLC, Balderton Capital and SoftBank Vision Fund [...]

item.description: NEW YORK: Lucid Group Inc plans to boost electric vehicle output more slowly in 2026 after last year’s surge was marked by production struggles and faltering demand for battery-powered vehicles in the US.
